articles.headline: Return of 'Kirko Chainz' and In-N-Out runs: Kirk Cousins brings joy to Raiders
articles.description: From reviving 'Kirko Chainz' to treating teammates to In-N-Out, Cousins is encouraging the Raiders to find joy.
articles.headlineJa: 「Kirko Chainz」の復活とIn-N-Outでの食事：カーク・カズンズがレイダースに喜びをもたらす
articles.descriptionJa: 「Kirko Chainz」の復活から、チームメイトへのIn-N-Outの振る舞いに至るまで、カズンズはレイダースに喜びを見出すよう促している。
articles.body:
HENDERSON, Nev. --- It took eight weeks into Kirk Cousins' tenure with the Las Vegas Raiders for the veteran quarterback to unlock his alter ego, "Kirko Chainz."

The Raiders defeated the New York Jets 38-33 in comeback fashion on the road Sunday, snapping a four-game losing streak and improving to 4-4 -- the first time the team has been .500 or better through eight games since 2021. The accomplishment caused much-needed celebration, so on the long flight back to Las Vegas, Cousins took off his shirt and let his teammates place several expensive chains around his neck and watches on his wrist.

"It's been a while. The longer the flight, the more likely the chains," said Cousins, who recorded four total touchdowns in the win.

"Kirko Chainz" originated in 2022 when he started for the Minnesota Vikings. Cousins helped complete a comeback win over the Washington Commanders to improve to 7-1. On the return trip, Cousins went viral when a video of him swaying to Florida rapper Real Boston Richey's song, "Bullseye 2," while wearing his teammates' jewelry, circulated across the internet.

Raiders running back Dylan Laube was on the New Hampshire Wildcats when Cousins first channeled his alternate personality. Laube said it was cool to see at the time, but seeing Kirko Chainz in person was "funny."

"I mean, he loves the attention," said Laube, who was named AFC Special Teams Player of the Week. "... He's just an unreal person."

Raiders starting cornerback Eric Stokes said he "threw a little something" on Cousins' wrist. The large Millennium Ring necklace, which is from the iconic Japanese anime television series "Yu-Gi-Oh," came from defensive tackle Adam Butler.

All-Pro defensive end Maxx Crosby said he contributed in a big way, giving Cousins multiple watches and chains.

"Kirk is the man. ... One of the funnier dudes you'll ever meet," Crosby said. "He probably [has] the most dad vibe energy on the planet."

The return of Kirko Chainz is one of the ways Cousins has brought joy to the Raiders this season. He generated smiles and laughter in the locker room with his "wellness" celebration after he snuck into the end zone for a touchdown in the third quarter against New York.

Postgame, Cousins said his touchdown dance was a nod to the team's training staff. On Wednesday, he admitted Laube created the dance.

"I don't get my own jokes, I steal them from other people, and then I'm just a better megaphone," Cousins said. "Dylan came up with it, and then I was like, 'I'm going to use that.'"

Cousins has also led trips to In-N-Out Burger after every win. He invited more players each time, but the trips halted for a month during the team's losing skid. As the weeks grew and the losses mounted, Cousins said In-N-Out started sounding better.

articles.headline: RB Josh Jacobs not anticipating missing more time despite additional allegations
articles.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs said he's operating under the assumption that he won't have to sit out any more games than the six he already missed while on the NFL commissioner's exempt list despite the release of additional allegations against him.
articles.headlineJa: RBジョシュ・ジェイコブス、新たな疑惑浮上もさらなる欠場は想定せず
articles.descriptionJa: パッカーズのランニングバック、ジョシュ・ジェイコブスは、新たな疑惑が浮上しているものの、NFLコミッショナーのエグゼンプト・リスト入りにより既に欠場した6試合以上にわたって試合を欠場することはないとの前提で動いていると語った。
articles.body:
GREEN BAY, Wis. -- Packers running back Josh Jacobs said he's operating under the assumption that he won't have to sit out any more games than the six he already missed while on the NFL commissioner exempt list despite the release of additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse against him.

Those accounts were included in evidence regarding Jacobs' battery case that the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department released last week in response to a public records request. The records show that three women alleged abuse by Jacobs to the department in incidents dating to April 2021. The women came forward after learning of Jacobs' arrest in connection with an alleged domestic violence incident in May. 

Three days after Jacobs' attorneys dismissed the claims as "unsupported and stale allegations," Jacobs on Wednesday further defended himself. 

"It's one of those things for me where it's like, it really feels like an attack on me and who I am and my character," Jacobs said. "And at the end of the day, there's a lot of stuff being said about me that's completely false -- like, completely made up, and it's like people just run with it. And I can't change that.

"It's just one of those things where it's like, OK, all I can do is try to be who I am and try not to let the negative moments change who I am. And that was the biggest thing for me throughout this whole process. I didn't want to go to a place where I felt like I was closed off and I'm angry all the time because of what's going on in my life."

Jacobs pleaded no contest Sept. 10 to charges of battery and criminal destruction of property resulting from the May 23 incident with a woman at his home near Green Bay. He was convicted of battery and fined $1,000 and reached a deferred judgment agreement on a charge of damage to property.

Jacobs missed the first six games of the season while on the commissioner exempt list. He was cleared to play in Week 7 even though the NFL said it had not completed its investigation into violations of the personal conduct policy. Additionally, the NFL said over the weekend that it would look into the previous allegations that came to light with the release of those records.

The six games Jacobs missed while on the exempt list would count toward any suspension that might be forthcoming, but Jacobs said he does not believe he will miss any more games.

"With all the evidence that we have and that they have at this point, it's not one of those things where I'm sitting back on my hands like, 'OK, am I going to play this week?'" Jacobs said. "It's like, I kind of already know what it is, so it's like ... it's really just up to them to make their final decision. But like I'm not worried about feeling like I'm going to miss any more time than I already have."

The Packers have continued to support Jacobs.

articles.headline: Spanish medical official questions pitchside emergency protocols after De Miguel's death
articles.description: Spanish medical workers are questioning pitchside emergency protocols following the fatal on-field collision involving Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel.
articles.headlineJa: デ・ミゲルの死亡を受け、スペインの医療関係者がピッチサイドの緊急時プロトコルに疑問を呈す
articles.descriptionJa: テネリフェのフォワード、ヘスス・デ・ミゲルがピッチ上での衝突により死亡したことを受け、スペインの医療従事者たちはピッチサイドの緊急時プロトコルに疑問を投げかけている。
articles.body:
BARCELONA, Spain -- While Spain mourns the death of a soccer player who suffered a cardiac arrest after an on-field collision, the emergency medical treatment he received is falling under scrutiny.

Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel died Tuesday, a day after absorbing a heavy hit by the opposing team's goalkeeper during a match in Spain's second division and being rushed to a hospital.

Spain's National Police opened an investigation into possible involuntary manslaughter -- a standard procedure for a non-natural death. Investigators are expected to assess whether Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono's challenge went beyond the normal course of play.

But the incident also raised questions about the on-field treatment the 30-year-old player received after collapsing on the pitch Monday, including how quickly CPR was performed and whether medics used a defibrillator.

Elvira González, the president of Spain's Association of Nurses, Emergency Medics and Caregivers, told The Associated Press on Wednesday that her organization was seeking more information.

"We can't say if they acted correctly or incorrectly, but we can demand that all the emergency procedures follow international standards of correct practice," González said.

Team medical staff was at his side 20 seconds after De Miguel collapsed after being crunched in mid-air by Owono while disputing a high ball late in the game. Emergency workers quickly followed, running a stretcher to the scene in less than a minute.

It is unclear what medical attention De Miguel received during the 5 minutes he was prone on the pitch before being rushed off on a stretcher and placed in an ambulance waiting just off the field.

Some Spanish media reported that he received CPR in the ambulance and recovered a pulse, while others say he received CPR on the field. It has not been established whether a defibrillator was used.

The Tenerife soccer club did not answer repeated calls and an email request asking for more information about the emergency treatment De Miguel received.

"There is contradictory information," González said. "The first thing we need to know is where and when he supposedly recovered a pulse."

She said CPR must be performed from "minute 1" and that using a defibrillator is crucial.

"The first minutes are critical. You can only move a person once a pulse is restored," she said.

On-field treatment proved lifesaving for other athletes who collapsed on the field of play including Danish soccer player Christian Eriksen, whose heart stopped during a European Championship game in 2021. In the NFL, Damar Hamlin of the Buffalo Bills was treated with CPR and defibrillator on the field after he suffered cardiac arrest in 2023. Both survived.

Team owner wants answers Some local media say that the police probe is also looking into the immediate medical treatment De Miguel received at Tenerife's stadium. The National Police in Madrid and in Tenerife would not comment on that to AP.

articles.headline: Ravens look to stabilize crumbling season with QB Jacoby Brissett
articles.description: Given the veteran QB's recent track record, it remains to be seen whether Baltimore can truly salvage its season.
articles.headlineJa: レイブンズ、QBジャコビー・ブリスセットで崩壊寸前のシーズンを立て直せるか
articles.descriptionJa: ベテランQBの最近の実績を考えると、ボルチモアが本当に今シーズンを立て直せるかどうかは未知数だ。
articles.body:
OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- The Baltimore Ravens have dropped three straight games, lost star quarterback Lamar Jackson indefinitely and watched their playoff hopes quickly crumble.

Still, Baltimore is not throwing in the towel at the midway point of a 2026 NFL season that's spiraling downward.

The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, which shows they're not giving up on the season. But, given Brissett's track record, the Ravens have a better chance of stabilizing the season than saving it.

Baltimore (4-4), which is in last place in the AFC North, has a 6.4% chance of making the playoffs and an 0.5% chance of winning the division, according to ESPN Analytics. With such dismal odds and the uncertainty surrounding Jackson, Ravens general manager Eric DeCosta could have considered punting on the final nine games of the season by trading some starters and acquiring more picks for what is supposed to be a loaded 2027 draft.

Instead, the Ravens are trying to salvage a season that has been devastated by injuries at quarterback. Jackson is expected to go on IR with a right thumb injury he suffered in Sunday's 36-10 loss at the Buffalo Bills and is potentially out for the rest of the season. To make matters worse, Tyler "Snoop" Huntley, Baltimore's top backup, is out for the season with turf toe, according to Schefter and Rapoport.

The trade is a move that can curb a free fall in Jesse Minter's first year as a head coach and Declan Doyle's first as an offensive playcaller. The veteran Brissett offers hope of fielding a competitive offense.

The Ravens are so desperate at quarterback that they're starting undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano, who practiced with a brace on his injured right ankle, for Thursday night's game against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Baltimore's other two active quarterbacks on Thursday are Kedon Slovis and Austin Reed, both of whom were signed within the past three days. This means that the Ravens' three quarterbacks -- Fagnano, Slovis and Reed -- have combined for no previous starts, 23 pass attempts and no touchdown throws.

Brissett, 33, provides much-needed experience at quarterback but not a winning track record. He's never had a winning record in any of his 11 NFL seasons, losing 16 of his past 19 starts.

His career record of 23-50 (.315) is the second worst in the NFL among quarterbacks with at least 50 starts over the past decade. The only quarterback with a worse record over that span is Justin Fields (16-37, .302).

The reason Brissett is available is that he was benched by the Cardinals (3-5) and dropped to No. 3 on the depth chart. Baltimore has familiarity with him because Ravens quarterbacks coach Israel Woolfork was Brissett's quarterbacks coach in Arizona last season.

articles.headline: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
articles.description: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
articles.headlineJa: セインツのジョーディン・タイソンが練習に復帰、制限付きでの参加
articles.descriptionJa: ニューオーリンズ・セインツの新人ワイドレシーバー、ジョーディン・タイソンは、8月13日のジャグアーズとの合同練習で右ハムストリングを負傷して以来、水曜日に初めて練習に復帰し、今季初出場に向けて大きな一歩を踏み出した。
articles.body:
METAIRIE La. -- New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.

Tyson was listed as a limited participant on the injury report along with left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr., who also returned to practice following surgery on his ankle.

"You just got to let the medical side take its course, and when these guys become available, we'll continue to build off that plan," Saints coach Kellen Moore said. "But both guys have been working well and we'll just kind of let this week take its course. They're limited today and we'll see how the rest of the week goes."

Tyson was expected to be out at least two months after the hamstring injury, which occurred when he landed awkwardly after catching a pass during the Aug. 13 joint practice. Tyson was slow to get up after the injury but eventually jogged to the opposite sideline, though he didn't return to practice.

Tyson and the Saints have said the injury was not related to his previous hamstring issues from college.

"It was a contact injury," Tyson said Wednesday. "It's not like I was just running and I just pulled it. A guy pushed me very, very hard, a big dude at that, and kind of just went down on the sidelines."

The Saints have been cautious with Tyson, who was selected with the eighth pick of the 2026 NFL draft. Tyson had an extensive injury history before joining the Saints and missed three games for Arizona State last year with a hamstring injury. He did not do any on-field workouts at the NFL scouting combine as he rehabbed his hamstring issue and instead held a private workout for teams.

He also tore his ACL, MCL and PCL in his left knee when he was at Colorado in 2022, fractured his collarbone in 2024 and sprained his ankle in 2025, an injury that caused him to miss spring practices that year.

Tyson said he feels like the extended time to get himself right has been "a blessing."

"Kind of got a slow start to the NFL, so I got to kind of take my time and kind of really adjust to it," he said.

Tyson said he recently ran his fastest speed since his rehab began.

"I feel more explosive than I ever have," Tyson said. "So I think I'm doing pretty good. I think I'm doing just fine."

The Saints have tempered expectations for their rookie after so much time away from football. Moore said it was a matter of reacclimating Tyson and seeing the kind of volume he could handle and how his body responds.

"He's a dawg," quarterback Tyler Shough said. "I think he brings this mentality, this elusiveness, this versatility to our offense that it's hard to replace. At the same time, there's a lot of unknown. We haven't had a lot of reps with him. It could be even greater than we could imagine, it could be not a significant role as we may think. articles.headline: Champions League talking points: Are Como the real deal?
articles.description: Gab Marcotti, Rob Dawson, Mark Ogden and Sam Marsden run the rule over upstarts Como, plus all the other moments that mattered from Matchday 4.
articles.headlineJa: チャンピオンズリーグの論点：コモは本物なのか？
articles.descriptionJa: ガブ・マルコッティ、ロブ・ドーソン、マーク・オグデン、サム・マースデンが、新興勢力コモを徹底検証。第4節の重要な瞬間も網羅。
articles.body:
Matchday 4 of the UEFA Champions League league phase is in the books, which means we're at the midway point and the table is starting to take shape.

Juggernauts Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid have perfect four-from-four records and are sitting atop the 36-team ladder, with Arsenal not too far behind.

Statement wins from Como and Manchester United -- for very different reasons -- have both clubs well placed to survive the cut, while a number of players are putting their names up in lights after some stunning individual displays.

So, what to make of it all? ESPN FC writers Gab Marcotti, Sam Marsden, Mark Ogden and Rob Dawson are here to break down the action from Matchday 4.

- Will Man United's comeback save Carrick's job?

- As it happened: Fenerbahçe stun Liverpool, Como on cloud nine

- Yamal makes history as Barca thump Aston Villa

Q1. Are Como going to win this whole thing? The darlings of Europe have been charming us all season long in the Champions League, with big wins over RB Leipzig, Man United and Wednesday's 9-1 decimation of Lens. They're no slouches domestically, either, sitting in the top four of Serie A with 37 goals scored in 14 games across both competitions. Oh, and they have Nico Paz, who has six goals and seven assists already this season while also being the literal heir to Lionel Messi's Argentina No. 10 shirt, and Anastasios Douvikas (us neither) is the tournament's top scorer! So, how far can they go? Is there a more up-and-coming coach in the game than Cesc Fabregas? Can they keep it together? What is the secret sauce here?

Dawson: Como aren't going to win it, but they're fast becoming the team no one wants to play. Watching them close up against Manchester United, it was striking how well coached they are. Fabregas has got them so organised all over the pitch. Within that structure, they've got the flair and creativity of Paz. He ran the game against United and scored again against Lens. On top of all that, their stadium on the lake is cramped and uncomfortable for the opposition. It's an awkward trip for any team. Well on their way to reaching the knockouts in their first campaign in the Champions League, none of the favourites will fancy a two-legged tie against Como.

Ogden: I'm loving the Como story, partly because they are everything that Italian teams never are -- exciting, adventurous, risk-takers (sorry Gab, but I know you agree). Look, it isn't the fairytale story that some would have you believe thanks to very wealthy Indonesian ownership, but they are a breath of fresh air in both Serie A and the Champions League.

But no, they aren't going to win it all and I'd even suggest they won't even reach the quarterfinals because the Champions League is a much more unforgiving tournament in the spring and the big guns will not be caught by surprise by Como then. And who knows, Fabregas might be managing one of Europe's superpowers by then because one certainty is that this run of results are making him a hot

articles.headline: Dirk Kuyt hails 'another miracle in Istanbul' after Fenerbahce beat former club Liverpool
articles.description: Fenerbahce interim head coach Dirk Kuyt hailed "another miracle in Istanbul" after his side twice came from behind to beat Liverpool 3-2 in the Champions League on Wednesday night.
articles.headlineJa: ディルク・カイト、フェネルバフチェが古巣リヴァプールを下し「イスタンブールでまたしても奇跡が起きた」と称賛
articles.descriptionJa: フェネルバフチェのディルク・カイト暫定監督は、水曜夜のチャンピオンズリーグで、チームが2度の逆転劇を見せてリヴァプールに3-2で勝利した後、「イスタンブールでまたしても奇跡が起きた」と語った。
articles.body:
Fenerbahce interim head coach Dirk Kuyt hailed "another miracle in Istanbul" after his side twice came from behind to beat Liverpool 3-2 in the Champions League on Wednesday night.

Goals from Mason Greenwood, Archie Brown and Vedat Muriqi claimed the Turkish side's first Champions League win of the season and their first in any competition for four games, a feat the former Liverpool man compared to the Reds' famous Champions League final win over AC Milan in 2005, a year before he joined the English club.

"It was a very special night, I think not only for me, but everyone who loves Fenerbahce," said Kuyt, who took charge last week after Ismail Kartal resigned following the 2-1 defeat to rivals Galatasaray.

"We told each other to stick together, to be united. And also to keep believing in ourselves, and that is something [which] I learned from another club [that] means a lot to me, and that was Liverpool, the club we played against tonight.

"So I'm very happy with all the players, I'm very happy with all the people who were involved that we made a miracle tonight."

Fenerbahce are sixth in the Turkish Super Lig having lost four of their opening 10 games, but Kuyt said he hoped the victory could kickstart the team's season.

"Although we are in a very difficult situation, we have a chance to bring another miracle in Istanbul," he said. "And if you get that miracle, things can change in a positive way.

"But the reaction needs to come from us first ... If you create that atmosphere, even the best team in the world can get difficulties.

"And I think the win tonight was not an easy win, but it was not luck. I think at the end of the day, we deserved it. We create many chances. We keep pushing and we keep fighting against, in my opinion, one of the best teams in Europe."

- Liverpool bemoan 'cheap, messy goals' in loss at Fenerbahce

- Greenwood leads Fenerbahce rally to end Liverpool's perfect UCL start

- 'I'm not Mohamed Salah' - Bradley Barcola doesn't feel Liverpool pressure

Former Newcastle midfielder Emre Belözoğlu was announced as Fenerbahce's new permanent manager on Tuesday night.

After the win over Liverpool, Kuyt added: "He wished me all the best for this game and I said to him, 'I will make sure the team will have a good performance so you can have a good start.'"

articles.headline: Updated NBA championship, MVP odds: Rockets' odds shorten; Doncic leads for MVP
articles.description: San Antonio remains the favorite to win the NBA championship, but fast starts by Houston and Philadelphia have seen their odds shorten.
articles.headlineJa: NBA優勝・MVP予想オッズ更新：ロケッツのオッズが低下、ドンチッチがMVP筆頭に
articles.descriptionJa: サンアントニオが依然としてNBA優勝の最有力候補だが、ヒューストンとフィラデルフィアの好スタートにより、両者のオッズが低下している。
articles.body:
After jumping out to a Western Conference-best 7-1 record, the Houston Rockets have made a big move up the NBA Finals odds board to start the season.

Houston began the campaign with 13th-best championship odds at 35-1 and has shortened all the way to 14-1. BetMGM senior trader Anthony Parenti said in a release that the Rockets are now a championship liability for the sportsbook.

The Eastern Conference-leading Philadelphia 76ers continue to marginally improve for the 2026-27 title, going from +900 to +850 week over week. The Sixers entered the 2026 offseason at 60-1 for the NBA Finals before the acquisitions of Jaylen Brown and LeBron James massively improved their prospects.

The San Antonio Spurs and Oklahoma City Thunder remain the favorites for the championship but have lengthened slightly week over week, going from +285 to +290 and +380 to +450, respectively. The Boston Celtics and reigning champion New York Knicks at 10-1 are also among the top six.

There has also been significant movement in the MVP race to start the season. Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic has taken over favorite status at +200, claiming the top spot from Spurs center Victor Wembanyama, who began the season at +205 and has lengthened to +220 at DraftKings. Doncic is BetMGM's leading MVP ticket and handle attractor, according to a recent data release.

articles.headline: Sources: Jalen Hurts makes appearance at Eagles facility
articles.description: Sources said Wednesday was the first time some players had seen Jalen Hurts since he was put on injured reserve because of blood clots in his lungs.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者：ジェイレン・ハーツがイーグルスの施設に姿を見せる
articles.descriptionJa: 肺の血栓により故障者リスト入りして以来、水曜日に一部の選手がジェイレン・ハーツの姿を確認したのはこれが初めてだったと関係者は語った。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts made an appearance Wednesday at the team's practice facility, marking the first time some players had seen him since he was put on injured reserve because of blood clots in his lungs, team sources said.

Hurts sat in on the team meeting as well as additional meetings. He did not address the team but his presence did provide a morale boost for some, a source said.

Coach Nick Sirianni didn't answer directly when asked earlier Wednesday whether Hurts had been at the facility but said he had seen the quarterback.

"I've talked to him and am in constant communication with him and know he's resting and recovering," Sirianni said. "I miss him like crazy. But nothing new on that front. I know he's resting and recovering, and we're all still praying for him and hoping for a speedy recovery."

Hurts, 28, is expected to sit out the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in the quarterback's lungs.

Hurts was originally diagnosed with a superficial blood clot in London before the Eagles' Week 5 matchup with the Jacksonville Jaguars. He played in the game, flew home with the team and practiced in full the following Wednesday. A follow-up ultrasound that Wednesday evening showed the blood clot had moved, the team said.

He was put on IR on Oct. 17. Two days later, his agent, Nicole Lynn, and the team released a joint statement about Hurts, saying, "After further testing and monitoring, the current diagnosis is a deep vein thrombosis, as well as bilateral pulmonary emboli. He is clinically stable and has no significant functional limitations."

His treatment involves anticoagulation or "blood thinners," which prevents him from participating in any contact activities, including football.

Tanner McKee took over for Hurts and went 0-3, throwing two touchdowns and two interceptions. He is being replaced in the lineup this week by Joe Milton, who was signed off the Dallas Cowboys practice squad in mid-October.

The Eagles are looking to break a six-game losing streak Sunday when they host the division-leading New York Giants.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Juventus eye moves for Šeško, Balogun
articles.description: Juventus are keeping tabs on possible moves for forwards Benjamin Šeško and Folarin Balogun. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.body:
Juventus are weighing up approaches for Manchester United striker Benjamin Šeško and AS Monaco forward Folarin Balogun, while Atlético Madrid winger Álex Baena has caught the eye of Arsenal. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Juventus are weighing up approaches for Manchester United striker Benjamin Šeško and AS Monaco forward Folarin Balogun, with plans to land a striker in January, Calciomercato reports. The Serie A club are keen to acquire a physical front man in the next transfer window, when they are expected to have around €100 million available to reinforce their squad. Šeško, 23, hasn't featured for United since Sept. 16 in the EFL Cup against Brighton & Hove Albion due to injury, while a move for 25-year-old Balogun could be possible after Monaco accepted an initial €40m offer from Everton in the summer before the deal fell through.

- Arsenal are keeping tabs on Atlético Madrid winger Álex Baena, TEAMtalk reports. An offer worth €80 million is expected to be required to secure the 25-year-old's transfer, as the Gunners explore the market for a top option to play on the left flank. The Premier League side could face competition from Bayern Munich for Baena, who has scored five goals and provided three assists in 11 LaLiga matches this season. Arsenal could raise funds for this with the exit of midfielder Martín Zubimendi, amid interest from Real Madrid and Barcelona, according to TEAMtalk. The 27-year-old has struggled to start regularly since the arrival of Bruno Guimarães and the Gunners would want a fee around the €60m that they parted with to land him from Real Sociedad in July 2025.

- Manchester United are considering a move for Al Ahli striker Ivan Toney as they prioritize adding depth at the No. 9 position, according to Football Insider. The Red Devils are monitoring the 30-year-old, who has scored 12 goals in nine Saudi Pro League matches this season, with several other options also on their shortlist. Toney has been in Saudi Arabia since joining Al Ahli from Brentford in the summer of 2024.

- Barcelona are interested in Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Lucas Bergvall, according to Football Insider. Bergvall, 20, chose Spurs over Barcelona in 2024, but the Blaugrana are still monitoring him, though Spurs are in control of his future as his contract is not set to expire until the summer of 2031. The Sweden international has made four Premier League appearances this season and has also emerged on the radar of Napoli.

- Al-Hilal have ended their pursuit of Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, TalkSPORT reports. The Saudi Pro League club were strongly linked with a move for the 32-year-old over the summer, but they aren't expected to make a new approach for him in January, with no plans to free up any of their overseas player slots.
